title: Selling Sunset's Bre Tiesi Confirms No Reunion Filmed for Season Eight<gwmw style="display:none;"></gwmw>
htmlContent:
Bre Tiesi, the star of the Netflix reality series Selling Sunset, has revealed that the eighth season's reunion show has not yet been filmed. In an exclusive interview with Digital Spy, the real estate agent and reality TV star who starred in the popular show's latest season shared the news.

Fans have awaited reunion episodes in previous seasons, which typically air a week after the primary season finale. In these episodes, the cast can gather in a studio to rehash the season's drama, storylines, and unresolved issues. However, Tiesi confirmed that unlike season seven, there has been no movement on a reunion for season eight.

"I’m pretty sure at some point they will," Bre explained when asked about the possibility of a reunion show. "From my experience of being here, they don’t do it every season." She added that there hasn’t been any official word about filming a reunion episode yet, stating: "I think they’re doing it a little bit differently and I haven’t heard anything per se."

Despite the absence of a reunion episode, season eight of Selling Sunset still provided plenty of drama for fans. Bre's revelation about Chelsea Lazkani's husband, Jeff Lazkani, being unfaithful with her co-star was one of the biggest surprises. The revelation shook the cast and became a significant topic of discussion throughout the season.

Other standout moments include a unique 'dog funeral' that captivated viewers and a cameo appearance by Joey Essex, who was previously a Love Island: All Stars and TOWIE star.

Bre confirmed to fans that the intensity of the show's drama is genuine when asked about its authenticity. 

"It’s definitely genuine," she said. "A lot of this stuff implodes and it’s just months and weeks of filming. I think some of these situations aren’t as unavoidable as people think they are. " She also reflected on how difficult it can be for the cast to relive the events when the episodes air, adding: "We kind of just handle them in the best way we can, and it’s also traumatic for us to rewatch it and relive and hear everyone else’s opinion on it.

Despite the possibility of a reunion show, season eight of Selling Sunset has already proved to be as captivating and dramatic as ever, ensuring that fans are glued to their screens.
